name: sqs-consumer-lambda
description: SQS Consumer Lambda Function - POC for message processing

scripts.build-esbuild: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning --define:Reflect.decorate=true
scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist && cp package.json ./dist/ && npm install --prefix ./dist
